label: Years before, while Straker served Colonel Ross as jockey and then as trainer
quote: He has served the Colonel for five years as jockey and for seven as trainer
note: Twelve years of service up to now; Simpson's squandering of his fortune upon the turf (¶39) is also in this long past, undated.

label: When Fitzroy Simpson registered his bets against the favourite
quote: bets to the amount of five thousand pounds had been registered by him against the favourite
note: Before the catastrophe; not otherwise dated.

label: When Fitzroy Simpson came down to Dartmoor
quote: he had come down to Dartmoor in the hope of getting some information
note: Before Monday evening, when he met the maid; not otherwise dated.

label: Monday evening, before nine
quote: On that evening the horses had been exercised and watered as usual
note: ¶19 names the night: 'last Monday night when the catastrophe occurred'.

label: Monday evening, nine o'clock
quote: the stables were locked up at nine o'clock
note: Two lads walk up to the trainer's house for supper in the kitchen; Hunter stays on guard.

label: Monday evening, a few minutes after nine, the maid on the path
quote: At a few minutes after nine the maid, Edith Baxter, carried down to the stables his supper
note: The stranger stops her within thirty yards of the stables (¶21–24).

label: Monday evening, the maid and the stranger at the stable window
quote: ran past him to the window through which she was accustomed to hand the meals
note: The stranger speaks with Hunter through the window (¶26–29); Hunter goes for the dog; the maid flees to the house.

label: Monday evening, a minute later, Hunter runs out with the dog
quote: A minute later, however, when Hunter rushed out with the hound he was gone
note: Hunter locks the door before he leaves it (¶31) and searches round the buildings.

label: Monday night, when the other lads returned
quote: Hunter waited until his fellow-grooms had returned, when he sent a message to the trainer

label: Monday night, when Straker heard Hunter's message
quote: Straker was excited at hearing the account

label: Monday night, one in the morning, Straker leaves the house
quote: Mrs. Straker, waking at one in the morning, found that he was dressing
note: Rain pattering against the window; he pulls on his mackintosh and walks out towards the stables.

label: When the favourite was taken from his stall
note: Not dated by the text; before the struggle in the hollow, where the horse was (¶37). The police hold that Simpson took him out (¶46).
The struggle in the hollow on Monday night (¶19, ¶35–37), after Straker left the house at one and before seven in the morning.

label: The next morning, at seven
quote: Mrs. Straker awoke at seven in the morning
note: She finds her husband not returned and goes with the maid to the stables: the door open, Hunter stupefied, the stall empty.

label: The next morning, the search from the knoll and the finding of the body
quote: on ascending the knoll near the house
note: The lads roused, the search, the coat on the furze-bush and the body in the hollow (¶34–35).

label: When Hunter recovered from his stupor
quote: Hunter, on recovering from his stupor

label: When the remains of the stable-lad's supper were analysed
quote: an analysis has shown that the remains of his supper

label: When a reward was offered for the missing horse
quote: although a large reward has been offered

label: When Inspector Gregory arrived
quote: On his arrival he promptly found and arrested the man

note: Gregory arrests him on his arrival (¶39); Simpson's statement and the cravat put to him (¶40). Known to Holmes by Thursday morning.

label: Next Tuesday, at the fall of the flag
quote: at the fall of the flag next Tuesday
